records.subject: Welcome aboard, North Analytics
records.body:
Hi Kai,

Thanks for joining Wrenfield. If this is your first project-management tool for the team, the biggest adjustment is usually just getting into the habit of logging tasks here instead of a doc or a chat thread.

Happy to help with that transition.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: Following up on your downgrade question
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

Thanks for your note about downgrade timing -- your ticket is still open and a colleague is looking into the billing specifics for you, so you'll hear back on that directly.

In the meantime, happy to help with the next step in Wrenfield whenever you're ready. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time (teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time).

Would a short call this week help? I can walk through whatever's most useful.

Best,
Nadia
